messages:
maria_ng: quick sync notes from pair yesterday on compact coalescer + slot-smoothing. goal: reduce p99 tail during tenant microbursts without regressing unit cost
samir: saw the tail spike with tenant X doing 180 reqs in 2s. coalesce window current max=60ms which kills packing efficiency if we bias towards 20ms windows
jin_park: tradeoff summary: shrink windows -> better p50/p95; enlarge -> better GPU utilization and lower per-token cost. we need hybrid policy
alex_r: customer constraint: interactive routes need <150ms 95th for REPL-like workloads. curious if we can do per-route SLAs with separate queueing policies
maria_ng: design sketch: two admission paths. fastpath for tiny requests (<128 tokens) with minimal coalesce. compact path for larger requests with smoothing credits and occasional forced drains
samir: starvation risk: if fastpath dominates, compact path starves and causes large model batches to have high latency
jin_park: mitigation: compact_drain_every N rule + soft-evict hysteresis. e.g., after N fastpath drains, force a compact flush even if underfill
alex_r: also need KV cache sensitivity: delaying compacts can evict KV entries. propose attaching cache_score per-request to influence flush priority
maria_ng: metrics we must emit: headroom_gauge, drain_rate, fastpath_ratio, coalesce_fill_histogram, compact_evicts_counter. ops needs alert fastpath_ratio>0.8 for 30s
samir: control knobs example:
```
coalesce:
  min_window_ms: 1
  max_window_ms: 50
  smoothing_alpha: 0.15
  fastpath_quota_per_sec: 200
  compact_drain_every: 25
  eviction_hysteresis_ms: 250
```
jin_park: smoothing_alpha needs per-tenant cooldown to avoid oscillation with diurnal bursts. add step_limit_per_sec to cap window changes
alex_r: rollout: small fleet A/B, synthetic bursts + KV-hit-rate checks. if cost regresses >10% rollback. ops will prepare alert dashboard
maria_ng: next steps: I'll draft RFC+test plan and ping infra for conservative rollout. tagging @deploy-bot to queue perf suite
deploy-bot: queued perf suite: compact-coalesce-smoke x4, us-west-2, ETA 220s
